## 07ab476607b3

**Reproduced defect: strict scalar coercion.** Generator SHA-256 `a109f4485d7230a4a282be3379f707d3ac67e728269264d409120201edf2acc4`, rule hash `11cea0a09738`, was left unchanged.

The focused audit preset passed its 6 task tests and semantic gate, and the full strict battery passed 11/12 stages. `defect_lint` alone failed with 78 warnings because `generate` accepts invalid scalar forms across three bands: boolean/string/float seeds, boolean or negative sample indices, and string/float integer overrides. The small reproducer shows `seed=True`, `sample_index=-1`, `a_size=7.75`, and `grid_h="10"` all being accepted and normalized into lawful scenes instead of rejected.

Evidence: `checks/audit/07ab476607b3/strict-scalar-reproducer.json`, `checks/audit/07ab476607b3-battery/checks/07ab476607b3_audit_defect_lint.log`, and `checks/audit/07ab476607b3-battery/checks/07ab476607b3_audit_battery_summary.json`.

No semantic, profile, override-observability, diversity, Racket, or authority defect was found in the finite battery. The audit target was not patched.
